title: Monotony
summary: MONOT'ONY, noun [Gr. sole, and sound.] 1. Uniformity of tone or sound; want of inflections of voice in speaking; want of cadence or modulation. 2. Uniformity; sameness. At sea, every thing that breaks

inlines.v: MONOT'ONY, noun [Gr. sole, and sound.] 1. Uniformity of tone or sound; want of inflections of voice in speaking; want of cadence or modulation. 2. Uniformity; sameness. At sea, every thing that breaks the monotony of the surrounding expanse attracts attention.
